STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-NORMAL_PENCIL.title: Ordinary Pencil
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-NORMAL_PENCIL.descripti: The first time you [gold]Compose[/gold] each combat, draw 2 cards.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-NORMAL_PENCIL.flavor: What does it mean for something to be ordinary and taken for granted...?
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-SHOUT_OF_SOUL.descripti: The first time you [gold]Compose[/gold] each combat, draw [blue]5[/blue] cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-SHOUT_OF_SOUL.flavor: My lyrics are the cry of my soul!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-SHOUT_OF_SOUL.title: Cry of the Soul
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-SOYO_BASE.title: Soyo's Bass
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-SOYO_BASE.description: Whenever you play 3 Skill cards, gain [blue]{AtFieldPower}[/blue] [gold]atField[/gold].
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-SOYO_BASE.flavor: The steady rhythm that supports everything.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI_DRUM.title: Taki's Drums
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI_DRUM.description: The fifth card you play each combat is played an additional time.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI_DRUM.flavor: The beat that keeps the performance driving forward.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON_GUITAR.title: Anon's Guitar
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON_GUITAR.description: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Collectible[/gold] to your hand.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON_GUITAR.flavor: A guitar that always brings a fresh surprise.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-RAANA_GUITAR.title: Raana's Guitar
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-RAANA_GUITAR.descriptio: Whenever [gold]Leftover Parfait[/gold] is Exhausted, heal [blue]{HealAmount}[/blue] HP.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-MATCHA_PARFAIT.title: Matcha Parfait
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-MATCHA_PARFAIT.descript: A marker relic from Feed the Cat's reward route.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-MATCHA_PARFAIT.flavor: A small sweetness shared before it melts.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-EMPTY_PARFAIT.title: Empty Parfait
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-EMPTY_PARFAIT.descripti: A marker relic from Feed the Cat's penalty route.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-EMPTY_PARFAIT.flavor: Only the shape of sweetness remains.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-BURNING_STAGE_DEVICE.de: On pickup, halve Max HP, rounded up. The first Compose each turn grants 1 Energy, draws 1 card, and adds 1 Replay to its lyric; composing with that lyric again this turn adds another Replay.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-BURNING_STAGE_DEVICE.fl: Passion turns even life itself into fuel for the stage.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-MASSACRE_STAGE_DEVICE.d: On pickup, lose all Gold and give every card currently in your deck Inspiration and Epiphany. Combat rewards no longer contain Gold or cards.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-MASSACRE_STAGE_DEVICE.f: Nothing beyond the stage is needed anymore.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-HUNTING_STAGE_DEVICE.de: After the opening draw each combat, Exhaust 2 Collectibles from the draw pile first, filling randomly if needed. The first 3 cards Exhausted each turn grant 3 atField and draw 1 card.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-HUNTING_STAGE_DEVICE.fl: There is nowhere to hide beneath the spotlight.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-FINALE_STAGE_DEVICE.des: At combat start, gain 2 Energy, draw 2 cards, and gain a Star Stone. The first non-X card each turn costs 0. At the end of the sixth normal player turn, take 999 unblockable damage.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-FINALE_STAGE_DEVICE.fla: Fate leaves only six breaths before the finale.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-REPRODUCTION_STAGE_DEVI: On pickup, randomly transform a permanent card and preserve upgrades when possible. The next card permanently added to your deck is upgraded and gains Epiphany.
After the ending, the story begins again in another form.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-DESIRE_STAGE_DEVICE.des: On pickup, add 2 Stage Tomatoes to your permanent deck.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-DESIRE_STAGE_DEVICE.fla: A desire to be seen, and to stand upon the stage once more.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-COMPETITION_STAGE_DEVIC: Choose 3 playable, non-X Attack, Skill, or Power cards. Permanently increase their base cost by 1, add 1 Replay, and give them Epiphany. Add 2 Stolen Shines to your permanent deck.
Radiance competes with radiance, while their prices intertwine.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-FAREWELL_STAGE_DEVICE.d: Remove 1 removable card from your permanent deck.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-FAREWELL_STAGE_DEVICE.f: A farewell makes the stage a little lighter.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-PRIDE_STAGE_DEVICE.desc: Upgrade 1 upgradable card in your permanent deck.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-PRIDE_STAGE_DEVICE.flav: Stand tall and accept the light that belongs to you.
Gain 1 Potion slot and, if current rules allow it, gain a random Rare Potion.
An interlude is brief, but long enough to prepare for the next act.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-STAR_PICKING_STAGE_DEVI: Gain a legal, unowned relic using Common, Rare, and Ancient rarity weights. Stage Devices are excluded.
Reach out. That star may already be waiting for you.
